instructions: The owner's Android phone, driven through the Hermes app's Accessibility service. It acts only while the owner has armed control on the phone (Hermes app: Me > This phone > Control); Keel cannot arm it, and his Stop on the phone ends any call at once. Start with phone_state: indexed on-screen elements and a screenshot. Prefer index over x/y; coordinates are physical screen pixels. A successful action means it was dispatched, not that it worked: read phone_state again to verify. When a call says control is not armed or was stopped, tell the owner and do not call phone tools again until he says control is on.

tools.name: phone_state
tools.description: Read the phone's screen: indexed elements (role, text, id, bounds, checked/selected/focused, clickable/editable/scrollable) and a screenshot. Defaults to the focused screen without keyboard or background windows.

scope.description: focused foreground screen (default) or all windows, foreground first

tools.name: phone_screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of the phone's screen.

tools.name: phone_list_apps
tools.description: List the apps installed on the phone (label and package).

query.description: filter by label or package substring

tools.name: phone_list_windows
tools.description: List the phone's open windows with their ids.

tools.name: phone_wait
tools.description: Wait on the phone for the screen to settle, at most 10 seconds.

tools.name: phone_tap
tools.description: Tap an element of the phone's screen by index, or a point by x/y.

index.description: Element index from the latest phone_state

method.description: auto (default) taps checkable controls with one gesture and otherwise uses Accessibility with fallback on explicit rejection; gesture forces a physical tap; accessibility never falls back

tools.name: phone_long_press
tools.description: Long-press an element by index, or a point by x/y.

index.description: Element index from the latest phone_state

tools.name: phone_swipe
tools.description: Swipe or drag on the phone's screen from x/y to x2/y2.

tools.name: phone_scroll
tools.description: Scroll the phone's screen, or a scrollable element by index, to reveal content on one side.

direction.description: content moves to reveal this side

index.description: Element index from the latest phone_state

tools.name: phone_type
tools.description: Type text into an editable element of the phone (by index, else the focused field). Replaces its content unless append is true.

index.description: Element index from the latest phone_state

submit.description: press the keyboard's enter after typing

tools.name: phone_key
tools.description: Press a system key on the phone.

tools.name: phone_open_app
tools.description: Open an app on the phone by package name or label.

tools.name: phone_activate_window
tools.description: Bring a window of the phone to the front, by its id from phone_list_windows or by app.
